description: Presidential Secretariat - Appointed Mr.K.A.P.Ransinghe PC,Senior Additional Solicitor General as the Attorney General with Effect From 12th July 2024.
categorisation: This gazette content announces the appointment of a specific individual (Mr. Kulatileka Arthanayake Parinda Ranasinghe, PC) to a government position (Attorney General). It names the person and their new title but does not include any detailed description of the portfolio responsibilities or duties of the Attorney General. This fits the definition of a People Gazette (Type 2).
